submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I tested an Fe:V ≈ 1:1 composition (#99) and then the Fe-rich, V-poor corner (#83, #106). Photocurrent rose as Fe went up and V went down: #99 gave 0, #83 gave 1.5e-7 A and #106 gave 2.4e-7 A. #106, the lowest-V member of the Fe-rich compositions, gave the highest photocurrent.

rejected.reason: Measured photocurrent was 0; the FeVO4-like Fe:V≈1:1 region was inactive under 2.4 eV illumination
Measured 1.5e-7 A, lower than #106; it has more V (0.156 vs 0.141)
